world.prologueLine: Have you ever imagined being a cat?
world.prologueSub: No errands. No deadlines. Just walking toward whatever catches your eye, and quietly getting to know it.
world.introBody: Become the black cat and visit an island above the clouds. Start with Hyakki Lantern City's free demo and the tamago.exe exhibit in progress, then use the map to explore or fish for smaller projects. Take your time.
world.introControlsPc:
WASD  walk　/　Mouse  look around
Shift  run　/　Space  jump　/　E  interact
world.introControlsTouch:
Stick at bottom-left to walk
Drag the screen to look　/　Buttons at bottom-right to jump and interact
world.kittensAllFound: Every kitten is home. The light on the island begins to turn.
world.fishingEarly: Not yet — wait a little longer.
npcGuideLines: You made it. This island is what the inside of his head looks like.
The Hyakki Lantern City and tamago.exe exhibits are just ahead. Hyakki Lantern City has a free demo to play, while the new tamago.exe presentation is still taking shape.
Use the map to visit any place you like. More projects swim in the pond, tools wait in the workshop, and the years he has lived run along the tail.
Oh — and they say this island has a curious shape when seen from above. Climb up to the head and look.
npcGuideDoneLines: Every kitten is back. Thank you.
You're good at finding things that don't announce themselves. A little like him.
The light is turning. Stay a while longer.
npcJuniorLines: Oh — a cat. …Never mind, talking to myself.
Kashin led our seminar. When my code broke and I was stuck, he never just handed me the answer.
He'd ask, 'What's happening right now? How far is it still correct?' — and narrow the problem down with me.
In the end I fixed it myself. I'm fairly sure that was the point.
npcAgentLines: Three subjects under observation: humans, large language models, reinforcement learning.
Same board, same constraints, same one-hit-kill. Still, all three choose differently.
Reinforcement learning looks only at survival probability. Cold, but strong.
The language model tries to read context, and now and then hallucinates a rule that was never there.
Humans — they bet on instinct. That, the designer said, was the most interesting result of all.
world.kittenEar: High places are scary, but the view is worth it. When he meets a technology he doesn't know, he breaks it into small pieces and gets something running before he improves it.
world.kittenTail: Not many people walk this far. When he gets absorbed in something, he polishes the smallest details and forgets the time.
world.kittenPond: He wrote every sign on this island himself. Chinese is his first language — he taught himself Japanese all the way here.
world.milestoneFutureBody: Expected to graduate in March. The rings after this one have yet to form.
world.revealTitle: The island was shaped like a cat
world.revealBody: You never notice while you're walking on it. Sky above, clouds below. And yet, seen from up here, it was a cat all along.
world.mapDescription: A cat-shaped island with two featured project exhibits, a pond, workshop, lookout and your current position.
world.mapTravelHint: Choose a place to travel to a nearby safe spot. You can also take the scenic route on foot.
world.helpNavigation: Walk up to an exhibit or building and press E to explore it. Press Esc to release the mouse and open the map or settings. Use Return if you lose your way.
world.helpSettingsNote: Light quality reduces resolution and shadow detail. Reduced motion keeps the introductory camera, water ripples and ambient movement calm.
